audience: print-on-demand sellers who make and sell custom products with Printify

useCases.title: Check order status and tracking numbers
useCases.text: The AI lists orders in a shop, filtered by status or SKU, and reads each order's shipments with carrier and tracking numbers. You see what is in production and what shipped.

useCases.title: Review your products and their publish status
useCases.text: The AI lists products in a shop and reads one with its variants, images, print areas and publish status. You can find products that are not published yet.

useCases.title: Compare print providers and options for a product type
useCases.text: The AI lists catalog blueprints (such as a unisex t-shirt), the print providers that make a blueprint, and the sizes and colors each offers. It helps you choose a provider.

useCases.title: Get a shipping quote for items to an address
useCases.text: The AI prices shipping for line items to a destination address. It only quotes the price and does not place an order.

useCases.title: Publish a product to your sales channel
useCases.text: The AI publishes a product to the shop's connected sales channel, such as Shopify or Etsy. It locks the product and pushes the fields you choose to the store.
